title: SimpleVanish+
description: SimpleVanish is a small vanish plugin for Paper and Spigot servers that allows staff to become invisible to regular players. It includes optional flight, creative mode, invulnerability, private join/leave handling, action bar reminders and more.
body:
# SimpleVanish+

A lightweight and easy-to-use vanish plugin for Paper and Spigot servers.

SimpleVanish allows staff members to become invisible to regular players while providing useful moderation features such as flight mode, invulnerability, private joins, and configurable messages.

## Features

* Toggle vanish with `/vanish`
* Vanish yourself or other players
* Hidden from players without permission
* Staff with `simplevanish.see` can still see vanished players
* Optional flight while vanished
* Optional creative mode while vanished
* Optional invulnerability while vanished
* Hide join messages while vanished
* Hide leave messages while vanished
* Action bar reminder while vanished
* Lightweight with no dependencies

## Commands

| Command            | Description                           |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------- |
| `/vanish`          | Toggle your vanish status             |
| `/vanish <player>` | Toggle another player's vanish status |
| `/fly`             | Toggle flight                         |

## Permissions

| Permission                   | Description          |
| ---------------------------- | -------------------- |
| `simplevanish.vanish`        | Use `/vanish`        |
| `simplevanish.vanish.others` | Vanish other players |
| `simplevanish.see`           | See vanished players |
| `simplevanish.fly`           | Use `/fly`           |
| `simplevanish.fly.others`    | Use `/fly <player>`  |

## Configuration

SimpleVanish includes configurable messages and options for:

* Join/leave message suppression
* Automatic flight
* Automatic creative mode
* Invulnerability while vanished
* Customizable chat messages
* Customizable actionbar

## Why SimpleVanish?

Many vanish plugins come packed with features that small and medium-sized servers don't need. SimpleVanish focuses on doing one thing well: providing a reliable vanish system with a few essential moderation tools while remaining lightweight and easy to configure.

Perfect for staff teams, moderators, and server administrators who want a straightforward vanish solution without unnecessary complexity.
